references.text: The Israelites completed all the work on the tabernacle exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses; this same formula of obedience is used.
The Israelites did all the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses, and Moses blessed them for their obedience.
Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him; this is the same expression of obedience to God's commands.
The Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses regarding the arrangement of the camp; a parallel formula of obedience.
Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
The Israelites celebrated Passover just as the Lord had commanded Moses; this is the same pattern of obedience.
Moses spoke to the Israelites all that the Lord had commanded him to say to them.
Joshua did just as the Lord had commanded Moses; this formula of obedience continues into the next generation.
